name: NR-00a start-up preload: the first world start used the modlets read in the background at plugin load
description: Runs before NR-00 changes any modlet file. The modlets are read, resolved and serialised on a worker thread at plugin load; the first world start only publishes them when no modlet file changed in between. Admin edits later in the run take the normal path (NR-00 onwards).
